settings.hero_lede: Orders heading out across the continental United States, sets fitted in the Sunrise bay, and vans working driveways around Broward. Plus the videos and tips we end up repeating every week.
settings.gallery_lede: Captions describe the order or the job each tile stands for. Photography is being collected now — these are illustrations until it lands.
settings.videos_lede: Short, no-nonsense walkthroughs of the questions we answer most, for customers ordering online and for customers standing at the counter. These are in production — call us in the meantime and we will just explain it.
settings.videos_note: Want the short version now? Every topic above is written out in full in the tire care guides.
settings.tips_lede: The advice we give on the phone, written down so you can check it in your own driveway — wherever that driveway is.
settings.cta_title: Your order could be the next one out
settings.cta_lede: Tires shipped anywhere in the continental United States, free to the Sunrise shop if you want them fitted, and the van for driveways around Broward.

settings.caption: Order out the door — 4x Continental tires
settings.detail: Picked from the distributor closest to the customer, boxed and on its way without passing through a warehouse of ours.

settings.caption: Ship to store — set checked in at the Sunrise counter
settings.detail: Size, load index and speed rating read off every sidewall and matched to the order before anyone books the install.

settings.caption: Install bay — full set fitted after a ship-to-store order
settings.detail: Mounted, balanced, new valve service and every lug torqued to spec.

settings.caption: Mobile install — driveway call, Plantation
settings.detail: Mat down, jack set, tire machine and balancer running off the van. The car never moved.

settings.caption: Wheel and tire package — staggered fitment, shipped
settings.detail: Offset and clearance confirmed with the customer first, then mounted and balanced as a package before it shipped.

settings.caption: Alignment rack — Sunrise shop
settings.detail: Post-install alignment with a before-and-after printout for the customer.

settings.caption: Fleet order — six work vans, Tamarac yard
settings.detail: Ordered online, shipped to the shop, fitted on site. Tread depths recorded per vehicle, one invoice.

settings.caption: Packaging check — freight damage caught at the counter
settings.detail: A scuffed box gets opened and inspected before it is handed over. If the tire is wrong, it goes back, not on your car.

settings.caption: Office-park flat repair — sedan, Fort Lauderdale
settings.detail: Screw through the tread. Dismounted, patch-plugged from the inside and rebalanced.

settings.caption: TPMS sensor replacement — SUV, Lauderhill
settings.detail: Dead sensor battery after eight years. Replaced in a work parking lot, light out.

settings.caption: Fitment call — sizes read off a door placard over the phone
settings.detail: Half the job is making sure the right tire gets ordered in the first place. That part happens before anything ships.

settings.caption: Brake service — front rotors and pads, Sunrise shop
settings.detail: Bay work, priced before the parts came out of the box.
